overview: LocoMuJoCo是一个用于全身控制的开源基准库，旨在促进模仿学习和强化学习的研究。该库统一了MuJoCo及MJX和MjWarp后端，提供了多种人形、骨骼和四足机器人模型，并配套了动作捕捉数据集及重定向流程。通过模块化架构支持观测、奖励和领域随机化设置，并提供基于JAX的算法实现以支持端到端的即时编译训练，同时具备Sim-to-Real部署能力。

highlights.text: LocoMuJoCo提供了一个整合了CPU与GPU后端、包含多种机器人形态及其对应动作捕捉数据的统一基准平台。
highlights.evidence: The library couples MuJoCo (CPU) with MJX and the MjWarp backend (GPU) under a single API, exposes 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments, and ships a curated native motion-capture dataset for every humanoid, to which it can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1.

highlights.text: 该库利用模块化设计支持多种功能的可替换性，并结合JAX实现以提供高性能的端到端训练与Sim-to-Real部署支持。
highlights.evidence: A modular plug-in architecture makes observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization fully interchangeable, while compact JAX implementations of many RL and IL algorithms provide JIT-compiled end-to-end training, and the companion loco-mujoco-real repository provides sim-to-real deployment.
